# Hilti

> Hilti's Engineering Center provides construction professionals with comprehensive technical resources, software tools, and design solutions for structural connections, firestopping, and building information modeling.

Hilti serves construction engineers and architects with a dedicated Engineering Center platform offering access to professional-grade engineering software, CAD/BIM objects, technical guides, and specialized design tools for anchor systems, firestopping, and MEP applications.

## Key Topics

- PROFIS Engineering Software Suite
- Anchor Design
- Firestopping Solutions
- Structural Connections
- BIM/CAD Objects
- Firestop Selector
- SPEC2SITE
- MEP Systems
- Engineering Resources
- Technical Guides
- CAD Integration
- Construction Engineering

## Engineering Center

- [Welcome to the Engineering Center - Hilti USA](https://www.hilti.com/engineering): Engineering Center community platform with technical resources for construction engineers and architects
